hypothesis: Negative first-release monthly net foreign purchases of U.S. corporate stocks, interpreted as a contrarian cross-border equity-flow signal, identify frozen V11 U.S.-equity de-risk events that are too early and improve risk-adjusted performance versus frozen V11 and an availability-matched unconditional retention control.
selection_metric: No within-family selection. Evaluate the single frozen candidate against V11 and C-TIC-FLOW-ALWAYS, then apply every deterministic, paired-bootstrap and cumulative-DSR gate.
expected_outputs: V11-CONTROL metrics and frozen target fingerprint
all seven fixed-fold metrics plus 2020+ and 2022+ slices
factor-library publish plus remote readback if and only if ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS=true
formal-run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 result manifest
allowed_changes: risk-on exactly when latest point-in-time-available TIC net foreign purchases of U.S. corporate stocks is <0
latest observation must be no more than 45 calendar days old
on factor-available frozen V11 U.S.-equity de-risk events retain exactly 50% of nasdaq/sp500 reductions when risk-on

data_definition.source: U.S. Treasury TIC monthly release archives
data_definition.series_break: 2023-02 Form S to expanded Form SLT
data_definition.old_regime: snetus Grand Total Corp Stocks net foreign purchases
data_definition.new_regime: slt_table1 Grand Total U.S. Corporate Equity net U.S. sales, normalized to same economic sign
data_definition.sign_convention: positive means foreign residents are net buyers/increase holdings of U.S. stocks

matched_control.rule: retain exactly 50% of nasdaq/sp500 reductions on every factor-available frozen V11 U.S.-de-risk event regardless of TIC sign

shared_rules.event_scope: unique execution dates on which frozen V11 report.trades is non-empty
shared_rules.eligible_event: current V11 event reduces nasdaq and/or sp500 versus prior V11 event target

pass_fail_gates: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe
gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or negative cash
paired circular moving-block bootstrap: block 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260822
ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap and DSR gate

factor_library_promotion.action: export -> validate -> import -> complete -> remote readback
factor_library_promotion.failed_or_near_miss_policy: retain as research evidence; do not label validated/promoted

forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 parameter or target-path change
fixed dollar-flow threshold or magnitude threshold
percentile, z-score, expanding/rolling median or regime-specific threshold
multi-month averaging, accumulation, change, slope or acceleration
GDP, market-cap, FX, Treasury-flow, bond-flow or total-TIC normalization
removing or rescaling across the February 2023 series break
a second retrospective TIC equity-flow factor after results
dropping failed prior candidates from DSR accounting
follow_up_policy: No rescue search after formal performance. A promising but non-robust result may only become a separately preregistered prospective shadow with this exact rule unchanged.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_tic_foreign_equity_flow_v1.py -> tools/tic_foreign_equity_flow_v1.swiftpart + tools/tic_foreign_equity_flow_v1_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + shared ResearchTargetProvider/BacktestDailySimulator
